# GSAP

GSAP and ScrollTrigger 3.14.2 are copied with trailing whitespace removed from license-comment lines from the pinned npm `gsap` package's `dist/` directory. Original copyright and license headers are retained. They are served locally in the site's existing concatenated script, with no third-party runtime requests.

Source: https://gsap.com/ · License: https://gsap.com/standard-license/

To update, update the exact npm version, copy `dist/gsap.min.js` and `dist/ScrollTrigger.min.js` here, run `npm run build:js`, then the site's checks and motion tests.
